newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan to buy Advanced Therapeutic.
newsitem.headline: Elan to buy Advanced Therapeutic.

text.p: Elan Corp Plc said on Tuesday it would exercise its option to acquire Advanced Therapeutic Systems Ltd for a total cost of $141 million.
Elan said it would acquire all the outstanding Advanced Therapeutic stock for $36 per share in cash. Advance Therapeutic granted Elan a purchase option in July 1993, Elan said.
As a result of the purchase, Elan said it would incur a $141 million one-time charge in the quarter to September 30.
The transaction would be completed before the end of October 1996, Elan said.

Advanced Therapeutic was formed in May 1993 and subsequently funded through a rights offering to Elan shareholders. It was funding both drug delivery research using Elan's ETDAS, BEODAS and MIDAS technologies and new chemical entity and drug development research.
Elan President and Chief Executive Officer Donal Geaney said: "The decision to buy back Advanced Therapeutics follows a detailed review of the value of the ATS (Advanced Therapeutics) portfolio."
